subject: Replace multiple utility libraries with unified vmsdklib dependency (#477)
reason: The change is a build-system refactor: it merges the many vmsdk static libraries into a single vmsdklib archive and rewrites CMake link lines, plus a CMAKE_GENERATOR option in build.sh. The only source edits are behavior-free: constant renames in vmsdk/src/cluster_map.cc/.h (VALKEY_MODULE_CALL_ERROR_MSG -> kValkeyModuleCallErrorMsg with identical string contents, k_num_slots -> kNumSlots still 16384), removal of unused #includes, and adding the 'override' keyword to PrimaryInfoFanoutOperation::GetTargets(), which already overrode the base class's pure virtual.
